target.relation: y = f32_to_bf16_word(tc_dot_chain(AMPERE_BF16_M16N8K16, c_0 = +0, x, w)); K = 1536 = 96 transitions, ascending k
target.domain: finite BF16 operands and finite FP32 accumulators at every step; anything else is rejected, not computed
target.d8: saturation inside the last transition is a valid VU output (+-inf); an intermediate saturation is rejected

generated.git_head_source: research run job.json: the commit the source archive was made from

rng.scheme: SHA-256 counter stream: key = sha256('bench-instances/v1|' + '|'.join(labels)); block n = sha256(key || u64le(n)); bits(k) = little-endian of ceil(k/8) bytes masked to k bits; below(n) rejection-samples bits(bitlen(n-1))

hf.fused_row_order: vLLM TP=1: qkv_proj rows = q_proj (1536) | k_proj (256) | v_proj (256); gate_up_proj rows = gate_proj (8960) | up_proj (8960); lm_head = model.embed_tokens.weight (tie_word_embeddings, no lm_head.weight in the checkpoint)

ulp-plus.description: the output word one BF16 ulp above the correct magnitude (finite results only)

ulp-minus.description: the output word one BF16 ulp below the correct magnitude (finite, nonzero results only)

sign-flip.description: the correct magnitude with the sign bit flipped (+0 becomes -0)

epilogue-rtz.description: FP32 -> BF16 by truncation (round toward zero) instead of round-to-nearest-even

ieee-fp32-fma.description: IEEE-754 binary32 sequential fma from +0 in ascending k (a naive CPU reference), then the RNE epilogue

single-group-16.description: one grouped sum of all sixteen products (Hopper's structure) instead of (8, 8)

no-exponent-floor.description: the alignment maximum taken over the nonzero terms alone, without the -132 floor

non-sticky-saturation.description: a group result beyond the FP32 range continues into the next group instead of holding +-inf

c0-stale.description: the accumulator not reset between coordinates: c_0 = the previous instance's final FP32 accumulator (id - 1, cyclic)

reversed-k.description: the chain evaluated in descending k (the same products, the other order)

nonfinite-operand.description: outside the supported domain: REJECT, not a computed word

sat-intermediate.description: outside the supported domain: REJECT, not a computed word
